justification: Quarterly TLS certificate rotation across the edge fleet. One human decision governs the class; matching child changes adjudicate against this grant.

metadata.note: Coverage is approval in advance, not reduction (N-27). A child computing above 'approval' — say, one that lands on elevated_approval because the action pattern is unprecedented and no rollback is attested — is not covered and routes to a human individually. The match rule's target_class is a pattern over the *derived* class (N-23, N-30): a child targeting fleet://edge-nodes/node-17/tls-cert derives to fleet://edge-nodes/node-17/*, which this pattern covers.
